sys_script_include.description: Privileged provider administration (admin / app-admin only). Resolves the Generic Prompt capability, reports the active LLM provider, and switches between ServiceNow Now LLM (default), OpenAI, and Claude by flipping the One Extend definition-config default and publishing the matching model config. Also exposes the admin role check used by the advisor and settings widgets.
sys_script_include.name: IncentIQProviderAdmin
